# expo-mediapipe-pose

> Community-maintained on-device pose detection for Expo and React Native, using Google's MediaPipe Tasks SDKs with native Swift/iOS and Kotlin/Android implementations.

Use this library for camera pose events, customizable skeletons, named geometry, developer-defined feedback, local image/video inference, landmark recording/replay and opt-in segmentation. It is not an official Google/Expo package, a new pose model, or a medical assessment system.

The supported consumer API is TypeScript for Expo/React Native. Native inference requires an iOS/Android development build with compatible Expo modules; Expo Go and browser inference are unsupported. The internal Swift/Kotlin bridge is not a standalone native SDK distribution. The core entry point provides pure helpers, not inference.

Install expo-mediapipe-pose@^0.4.0 from npm. Version matters: main may advance independently. The older v0.2.0 GitHub tag contains the earlier camera API.

Coordinates, missing/unknown states, pose-index identity limits, cancellation and mask-lease ownership are part of the API contract. Physical-device performance, persistent person identity, repetition counting, exercise scoring and medical accuracy must not be inferred from build or fixture success. Landmark recordings do not contain camera video or mask files.

## Start here

- [Agent Skill](https://github.com/YosefHayim/expo-mediapipe-pose/blob/main/skills/expo-mediapipe-pose/SKILL.md): Exact install steps, a minimal camera example, common tasks and common mistakes, written for coding agents.
- [Live site](https://yosefhayim.github.io/expo-mediapipe-pose/): Landing page for the library.
- [Browser playground](https://yosefhayim.github.io/expo-mediapipe-pose/#playground): Try samples, webcam and local media, tune skeletons and rules, and copy Expo code. It does not add browser inference to the npm package.
- [README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/YosefHayim/expo-mediapipe-pose/main/README.md): Feature overview, install and config plugin steps, API examples and scope.

## README sections

- [Show a pose camera](https://github.com/YosefHayim/expo-mediapipe-pose/blob/main/README.md#show-a-pose-camera): Minimal PoseCameraView with permission, facing and frame limit.
- [Style joints and body parts](https://github.com/YosefHayim/expo-mediapipe-pose/blob/main/README.md#style-joints-and-body-parts): Skeleton options for joints, connections and body parts.
- [React to a condition](https://github.com/YosefHayim/expo-mediapipe-pose/blob/main/README.md#react-to-a-condition): usePoseRule with hold time, stale input and unknown states.
- [FAQ](https://github.com/YosefHayim/expo-mediapipe-pose/blob/main/README.md#faq): Platform support, privacy, models, frame rates, pose indices and segmentation leases.
- [Integration prompt](https://github.com/YosefHayim/expo-mediapipe-pose/blob/main/README.md#integrate-with-a-coding-assistant): Copyable prompt for your app's coding assistant.

## Project files

- [Changelog](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/YosefHayim/expo-mediapipe-pose/main/CHANGELOG.md): Release history and compatibility notes.
- [Agent instructions](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/YosefHayim/expo-mediapipe-pose/main/AGENTS.md): Repository layout, domain rules and checks for contributors and agents.
- [Playground development](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/YosefHayim/expo-mediapipe-pose/main/site/README.md): How the browser playground works and where it stops.
- [Example application](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/YosefHayim/expo-mediapipe-pose/main/example/app.tsx): Camera permissions, lifecycle controls, feedback and entry points for photo and video analysis.
- [Photo and segmentation example](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/YosefHayim/expo-mediapipe-pose/main/example/photo-panel.tsx): Local photo inference, pose selection, mask display and cleanup.
- [Video example](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/YosefHayim/expo-mediapipe-pose/main/example/video-panel.tsx): Sampled local-video inference, progress and cancellation.
- [Replay example](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/YosefHayim/expo-mediapipe-pose/main/example/replay-panel.tsx): Recording and replay of landmark sessions.
- [Native fixture guide](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/YosefHayim/expo-mediapipe-pose/main/example/fixtures/README.md): Public fixture provenance, cold-launch checks and mask pixel verification; these do not establish physical-camera performance.
